term: This page could not be loaded
definition: The code for this page could not be fetched or could not run, so nothing of it is shown. Often a new version was put up after the tab was opened, and reloading the tab fetches the current one.
basis: docs/workbench.md, the shell since Phase 17: "If the code for one cannot be fetched, as when a new version was put up after the tab was opened, the page says it could not be loaded", and "reloading the tab fetches the current version".
